checklistDetail.reopenModalBody: This will reset all checked items so the checklist can be completed again. A snapshot of the current state will be saved before resetting.
checklistDetail.pickupModeIntro: This pickup follows three phases: a host-led hospitality tour first, then an evidence audit, and finally office paperwork to close.
checklistDetail.handoverModeIntro: This handover follows three phases: a host-led hospitality tour first, then an evidence audit, and finally office paperwork to close.
checklistDetail.phase1Desc: Walk the guest through the vehicle together — controls, features, emergency kit, and anything they need to know. No items to tick here; this is your guided, hands-free walkthrough.
checklistDetail.phase2Desc: Work through each checklist item below. Flag any damage, missing equipment, or issues before handing over the keys.
checklistDetail.auditVehicleDataDesc: Record the current odometer reading, fuel level, and AdBlue level at the driver's door before starting the walkaround.
checklistDetail.auditEvidenceDesc: Photograph the vehicle condition thoroughly — front, rear, sides, and interior. These photos are mandatory for every handover and must be completed before you can finish this checklist.
checklistDetail.evidenceRequiredHint: At least one photo is required. No handover can be completed without evidence photos.
checklistDetail.auditChecklistDesc: Work through each section carefully. Use the flag button only for newly discovered issues or damage. All fields and steps on this page must be completed before handover.
checklistDetail.phase3Desc: Finalise the paperwork: sign the rental contract, verify ID, collect the security deposit, and hand over the keys. No digital steps required here.
checklistDetail.officeIdPhotosDesc: Attach a photo of the customer's ID for your records. This is optional and not yet synced.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorAuditIncomplete: All audit checklist items must be checked before handover can be completed.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorMissingData: Vehicle data (KM, fuel, AdBlue) and at least one evidence photo are required.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorOfficeIncomplete: All office confirmations (deposit, ID, contract) must be completed.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorHandoverIncomplete: All handover confirmations (keys and documents) must be completed.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorBlockingFlags: There are urgent open issues on this checklist. Resolve all urgent flags before completing handover.
checklistDetail.handoverErrorAllRequired: All audit items, vehicle data, photo evidence, and office/handover confirmations must be completed before handover can be completed.
checklistDetail.returnErrorAuditIncomplete: All return audit items must be checked before the return can be completed.
checklistDetail.returnErrorCloseIncomplete: All return close-out confirmations (keys, documents, contract) must be completed.
checklistDetail.returnErrorDepositRequired: Deposit status must be set before the return can be completed.
checklistDetail.returnKmBelowHandover: Return km cannot be lower than the handover km ({handoverKm} km).
